about: Configurations no golden combined, with iterate over one grant. Each case's about lists the pairs of configuration dimensions it reaches first, as dimension=value: ep the endpoint; tenant how the request names it; kind simplified or regular; eff the rule's effect; palg and salg the algorithm of its policy and of the set holding it; depth the set's depth; status the first status other than ACTIVE above it; iter and ialg the iterate pass and its algorithm; dial, syn, ph the predicate's fields, shape and placeholders; cond the condition; srules, spol, stop the other rules of the policy, the other children of the set, the other top-level nodes. A case named -q- asks whether the filter selects a resource the check denies. The first and the last case are controls: a DENY rule over an attribute that does not hold, true.
